hints.title: Prefix Ordering State
hints.text: Maintain boolean flags tracking which adjacent row pairs are already strictly sorted by previously kept columns.

hints.title: Column Deletion Condition
hints.text: A column must be deleted if any adjacent row pair that is not yet strictly sorted has a character inversion in that column.

hints.title: Iterative Resolution of Ties
hints.text: Maintain is_sorted array of length n - 1 initialized to false. For each column, check if strs[i][col] > strs[i + 1][col] for any i where not is_sorted[i]. If so, delete column. Otherwise keep column and update is_sorted[i] = true whenever strs[i][col] < strs[i + 1][col].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing subsets of columns yields exponential 2^C choices; greedy left-to-right retention is globally optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking prefix sorted states uses a single boolean array of length R - 1 in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should realize that once strs[i] is strictly less than strs[i+1] due to an earlier column, their future characters never matter.
complexity.notes: Greedy choice works because earlier columns have higher significance in lexicographical order.
